title: United Nations Secretariat Building in NYC, 1956 Vintage Snapshot Photo
location: United Nations Headquarters, New York City, United States
description: A low-angle view of the towering United Nations Secretariat Building in Manhattan, New York City, rising behind landscaped shrubbery and a long row of member nation flags. Processed in June 1956, the deckled-edge photograph captures this modernist International Style landmark during the heightened diplomacy and international tensions of the mid-Cold War era.
